## Overview

The decoding counterpart of [LRPPL01](../lrp-rli-pl-001/), so the pooled levels view can be read for both reading outcomes on one scale.

## Model

$$
\eta = \alpha_{\text{wave}} + \beta_G G
  + \beta_{\text{between}}\bar z_i + \beta_{\text{within}}(z_{it} - \bar z_i)
  + \gamma_A z(A) + \sum_c \gamma_c z(c) + u_{\text{child}}
$$

where $z_{it}$ is the standardised exposure logit at wave $t$ and $\bar z_i$ its
child mean. There is deliberately no own-baseline term.
